title: vitex trifolia var. unifoliolata
intro: Vitex trifolia var. unifoliolata, commonly known as Klu or Chinese Chaste Tree, is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual issues. The therapeutic actions of Vitex trifolia var. unifoliolata are attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitters, hormones, and the autonomic nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
